notice: Not a default learner plan. Select or generate only after goals and observed ability are known.

competencies.can_do: Open and close a simple conversation appropriately
Ask for repetition or clarification when meaning is unclear
Express an opinion and support it with a reason
Describe a past personal experience in sequence
Describe plans and likely next steps
Identify the main point of a clear short text
Identify gist from actually accessible clear speech
Write a clear short message for the intended audience
Compare options and explain practical trade-offs
Maintain a connected conversation on familiar topics
